title: Punishment for murder
description: Section 302 dealt with punishment for murder under the Indian Penal Code.
punishment: Death or imprisonment for life and fine

title: Causing death by negligence
description: Section 304A dealt with causing death by a negligent or rash act not amounting to culpable homicide.

title: Voluntarily causing hurt
description: Section 323 dealt with punishment for voluntarily causing hurt.

title: Voluntarily causing hurt by dangerous weapons
description: Section 324 dealt with voluntarily causing hurt by dangerous weapons or means.
punishment: Punishment as provided under the IPC

title: Voluntarily causing grievous hurt
description: Section 325 dealt with punishment for voluntarily causing grievous hurt.

title: Assault or criminal force to woman
description: Section 354 dealt with assault or use of criminal force against a woman with specified intent.
punishment: Imprisonment and fine as provided by law

title: Theft
description: Section 378 defined theft as dishonestly moving movable property out of another person's possession without consent.

title: Criminal breach of trust
description: Section 406 dealt with punishment for criminal breach of trust.

title: Cheating
description: Section 415 defined cheating and dishonest or fraudulent inducement.
punishment: Punishment provided under relevant IPC provisions

title: Cheating and dishonestly inducing delivery of property
description: Section 420 dealt with cheating and dishonestly inducing delivery of property.

title: Criminal trespass
description: Section 441 defined criminal trespass and house-trespass.
punishment: Punishment provided under relevant IPC provisions

title: Punishment for criminal trespass
description: Section 447 provided punishment for criminal trespass.

title: Defamation
description: Section 499 dealt with the offence of defamation.

title: Punishment for criminal intimidation
description: Section 506 provided punishment for criminal intimidation.
punishment: Imprisonment or fine or both, depending on circumstances

title: Word gesture or act intended to insult modesty of woman
description: Section 509 dealt with words, gestures or acts intended to insult the modesty of a woman.
